assertions.description: MediaSession.prototype.setMicrophoneActive is a function taking one required argument (length 1).
MediaSession.prototype.setCameraActive is a function taking one required argument (length 1).

assertions.test: (() => { const p = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') p.then(() => {}, () => {}); return p instanceof Promise; })()
(() => { const p = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false); if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') p.then(() => {}, () => {}); return p instanceof Promise; })()

assertions.description: In a fully active document, both returned promises fulfil with undefined.
assertions.test: (async () => { const a = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); const b = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false); if (!(a instanceof Promise) || !(b instanceof Promise)) return false; const [x, y] = await Promise.all([a, b]); return x === undefined && y === undefined; })()

assertions.description: Calling setMicrophoneActive() with no argument returns a promise rejected with TypeError instead of throwing synchronously (WebIDL promise-returning operation).
assertions.test: (async () => { let p; try { p = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(); } catch (e) { return false; } if (!(p instanceof Promise)) return false; try { await p; return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()

assertions.description: setMicrophoneActive(true) on the MediaSession of a removed (not fully active) iframe returns a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.
assertions.test: (async () => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.srcdoc = '<!doctype html><title>probe</title>'; const loaded = new Promise((r) => f.addEventListener('load', r, { once: true })); document.body.append(f); await loaded; const s = f.contentWindow.navigator.mediaSession; const m = f.contentWindow.MediaSession.prototype.setMicrophoneActive; f.remove(); let p; try { p = m.call(s, true); } catch (e) { return false; } if (Object.prototype.toString.call(p) !== '[object Promise]') return false; return await new Promise((res) => { const t = setTimeout(() => res(false), 2000); p.then(() => { clearTimeout(t); res(false); }, (e) => { clearTimeout(t); res(e && e.name === 'InvalidStateError'); }); }); })()

assertions.description: setActionHandler accepts the 'togglemicrophone', 'togglecamera' and 'hangup' actions that pair with these setters (an unknown action would throw TypeError).
assertions.test: (() => { for (const a of ['togglemicrophone', 'togglecamera', 'hangup']) { navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler(a, () => {}); navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler(a, null); } return true; })()

assertions.description: A user agent with a capture pause policy sets matching MediaStreamTrack muted state after setMicrophoneActive(false) resolves — requires a granted getUserMedia() capture; observe it in the capture pause-policy lab.
assertions.test: Needs user-granted microphone capture and a UA pause policy (Chromium applies none); exercised interactively in capture-pause-policy-lab.
